paite: Akum sawm-le-khatna huai kha ani masapen in hichi ahong hi a, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Tura Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura in Jerusalem tungthu a, 'Nuam e! Namte kongkhak aseta, kei lam ah akihong, hihsiatgawp a a-om vek ziak in, ka tan hoih ding ahita,' "
huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, aw Tura, ka hon dou ahi, tuipi in tuihualte avoktouh bang mai in na tung a hong pai ding in nam tampi ka hon sawl ding.
Huchi in Tura kulhte ahihse ding ua, a-insangte achimsak ding ua, amah a kipan aleivui tengteng ka kheuhsiang ding a, suangpi keu lel in ka bawl ding hi.
Tui lai a len phoukeuna mun ahi mai ding, ke'n ka chita ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Huchi in namte a ding in gallak ahi mai ding.
Huan atanu gam a omte namsau a hihlup ahih chiang un TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
"Ngai in, Tura tung ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, Kumpipate' kumpipa mallam a kipan in, sakolte toh sakol tungtuang mite, apawl leh mipi tampi mahmah ka hon pi dek ahi.
Gam ah namsau in na tanute athat ding; kulh abawl ding a, nang nanna ding in, nang douna ding in abawl ding, mual pawngte, nang douna kidalna abawlkhe ding hi.
Kulhbaang suksiatna bawl in, na kulh phelna ding, heipi in na insangte achimsak ding hi.

Asakol tam luat ding ziak in aleivuite un nang ahon tuam ding a, khopi akiphutvang nung a mite alut sek bang a, na kongpi a ahong lut hun chiang un, na kulhpi aling ding; sakol tungtuangte husa leh kidou kangtalai husa in.
Sakol khechin in achilse ding, na kongzingte; na mite athat khin ding, namsau in; na hatna bangbang lei ah achim ding hi.
Na gou thil gallak in ala ding ua; na van tengteng agubei ding uh; lei ah na kulhbaang achimsak ding ua, na inpi nuam ahihse vek ding uh, na suangte, na singte, na leivuite tui lai ah apai ding uh.
Ka khawlsak khin ding a, na lasak husate, na kaihging leng adai den ding hi.
Suangpi keu lel in ka hon bawl ding a, len phoukeuna ding na hong hi ding hi, dinsak nawn na hi kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in Tura khua kiang ah hichi in achi, na sung a kithahnate a-om hun a, miliamte athum hun chiang in na puk ging in tuipi gei gamte aling kei ding ua hia?

Tuipi tung a heutute tengteng atutphah ua kipan apaisuk ding ua, apuan thupite uh akoih ding ua, apuansilh zephoihte uh asuahkhe ding ua; linna in akivan zawta ding ua, lei ah atu ding ua, alingling ding ua, lamdang ahon sa ding uh.

Huchi in nang suunna la aphuak ding ua, na kiang ah, Khopi minthang, tuipi tung a hat, tuisiammi tengteng tenna sek, amah leh asung a tengte tengteng, mivialvakte'n ahon lauhlauh uh toh, na siatna thupi hi na tel e;
Na pukna ni in aling uh, tuikulh gamte; tuipi tuikulh alunglel ua, na man ni in, achi ding uh chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, khopi gam, kuamah luah louh khopi bang a ka hon bawl hun chiang in, tui thukpi ah ka hon tumsak ding a, tui thupi mahmah in ahon tum ding hi.
Lei nuailam ah, nidang a segawpsa, khuk thuk a paisate kiang ah ka hon tengsak ding a, kuamah in ahon luahlouhna ding un leh mihingte lak a thupina na muh nawn hetlouhna ding in.
Ka hon hihmang vengveng ding a, na om nawnta kei ding, mi'n hon zong mah le uh leng, ahon mu nawnta kei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
